### His Safety Deposit Box
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-january-21-2012.html
Passage: 1 Peter 4:19
Points:
- Rejoice in what God permits when difficult circumstances arise.
- Examine your life to ensure suffering is not the consequence of personal sin.
- Repent if convicted of wrongdoing, but rely entirely on God if suffering for Christ.
- Entrusting your soul means placing your life into God's safe keeping like a secure deposit.

### Rejoice and Be Glad
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/rejoice-and-be-glad
Passage: 1 Peter 4:13
Points:
- Fiery trials are not strange accidents but instruments that refine and purify faith.
- Suffering for Christ strips away self-reliance and fosters total trust in Him.
- Hardship endured for the Savior confirms a genuine union with Christ.
- Bearing suffering for His name prepares believers to experience great joy when His glory is revealed.
